[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Iron Mountain facility is part of the company data center business, which traces to a December 2017 purchase of IO Data Centers United States division for 1.3 billion dollars, acquiring four colocation data centers in New Jersey, Ohio, and Arizona, though this specific Virginia or Illinois location was not confirmed as part of that transaction in available sourcing this session. Iron Mountain itself was founded in 1951 as Iron Mountain Atomic Storage Corporation by Herman Knaust, a former mushroom entrepreneur who had purchased a depleted iron ore mine near Kingston, New York, went public in 1996, became a real estate investment trust in 2014, and as of 2023 is headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. The operators own current data center locations page describes its Northern Virginia presence as 400 plus MW across 142 acres in Manassas, and its own VA-1 and VA-2 solution guides separately describe an 83 acre campus that is the first of four planned campus data centers growing toward a nine facility, two million plus square foot development, confirming this is a real, large, multi building campus consistent with this registrys six separately numbered VA rows. This session resolved a street address for this specific VA-5 row. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 11580 Hayden Rd, Manassas, VA 20109 at 0.9 confidence, extending the same coherent, evenly spaced Hayden Rd numbering sequence, 11580, 11600, 11640, 11680, found across sibling VA rows in this same batch, treated here as the corroborating check in place of a named press or aggregator source, which this session did not find. Given this, the session applies 11580 Hayden Rd as this rows address, flagged for a future researcher to confirm against a named source if one becomes available.
